# Other things a contract declares

Settings and attachments, context and commands, hooks, mentions, actions, model providers and resources.

- [Settings and attachments](context:fs/authoring.settings-attachments): Settings people set, and attachments a run adds.
- [Context and commands](context:fs/authoring.context): Context items and /commands, static or dynamic, and the context/ folder.
- [Hooks](context:fs/authoring.hooks): Hooks that add information to a user message.
- [Mentions](context:fs/authoring.mentions): @ mentions: search, hover cards and the text the model gets.
- [Actions](context:fs/authoring.actions): Actions: stored buttons that call the system later.
- [Model providers](context:fs/authoring.providers): Model providers a system can add to the hub.
- [Resources, embedders and sectioners](context:fs/authoring.resources): Resources, embedders and sectioners a system serves.

Fns for this: fn:fs/read, fn:fs/write, fn:fs/edit, fn:fs/bash.
